title: Shadow Traffic – Cost Model (Telemetry + Storage + Scoring) [Sheet]
content:
Shadow Traffic Cost Model (v0.6)
Owner: Allison Grant (Observability)
Last update: 2026-02-11

What this sheet covers (explicitly)
- Incremental telemetry ingestion + storage (shadow pair + scoring events)
- Incremental scoring compute (async rubric runner)
- Does NOT include: incremental *shadow inference* GPU cost for candidate variants (owned by routing/runtime budgets). We have an optional section below to estimate it if needed.

Assumptions / inputs (edit these to match a tenant/route)
- Production request volume (control path): R_prod_per_day = 10,000,000 req/day
- Shadow sampling rate: s in [0.1%, 0.5%, 1%, 2%, 5%]
- Shadow targets per request: T = 1 (beta default). If multiple targets, multiply shadow/scoring rows by T.
- % of shadowed requests that produce “example artifacts” for drilldown (redacted prompt + outputs): a = 0.5% of shadow requests
- Avg tokens (for scoring only):
  - Scoring prompt tokens (includes control+shadow outputs + rubric): tok_score_in = 900
  - Scoring completion tokens: tok_score_out = 180
  - Total scoring tokens per scored pair: tok_score_total = 1,080
- % of shadow pairs that are eligible for scoring (some request types excluded in v1): e = 92%
- Scoring model/unit cost (internal): C_score = $0.70 per 1M tokens
  - Note: This is “blended” cost for rubric runner (includes grader model + worker overhead). Revisit after dogfood.

Telemetry payload sizes (post-redaction, compressed, averaged)
- ShadowPairEvent (request metadata + outcome + small refs): size_shadow_pair = 2.6 KB
- ShadowScoreEvent (rubric metrics + aggregate refs): size_score = 1.1 KB
- ExampleArtifact (redacted prompt + control+shadow text excerpts + debug): size_artifact = 8.0 KB

Pricing/infra rate assumptions (placeholders, used for relative sizing)
- Event ingestion (Kafka/stream + ETL + warehousing blended): C_ingest = $0.12 per GB ingested
- Hot warehouse storage (7–30d tables, compressed): C_wh = $0.095 per GB-month
- Object storage for raw events/artifacts (S3/GCS class): C_obj = $0.023 per GB-month

Retention defaults (beta)
- Raw ShadowPairEvent retained: 7 days (object)
- ShadowScoreEvent retained: 30 days (warehouse)
- Example artifacts retained: 3 days (object)
- Aggregates (daily/hourly rollups) retained: 180 days (warehouse)

Derived quantities (formulas)
- Shadowed requests/day: R_shadow = R_prod_per_day * s * T
- Scored pairs/day: R_scored = R_shadow * e
- Artifacts/day: R_art = R_shadow * a

- Daily GB ingested (shadow pair stream): GB_shadow_pair = (R_shadow * size_shadow_pair) / (1024^2)  [KB->GB approx]
- Daily GB ingested (score stream): GB_score = (R_scored * size_score) / (1024^2)
- Daily GB object artifacts: GB_art = (R_art * size_artifact) / (1024^2)

- Daily scoring tokens: tok_day = R_scored * tok_score_total
- Daily scoring cost: $score_day = (tok_day / 1,000,000) * C_score


Scenario table (R_prod_per_day = 10,000,000; T=1; e=0.92; a=0.5%)
All costs are *incremental* vs no shadow traffic.

| Sampling s | Shadow req/day | Scored/day | Artifacts/day | Scoring tokens/day | Scoring $/day | Ingest GB/day (pair+score) | Ingest $/day | Obj storage GB/day (artifacts) | Notes |
|-----------:|---------------:|-----------:|--------------:|-------------------:|--------------:|----------------------------:|-------------:|-------------------------------:|------|
| 0.1%       | 10,000         | 9,200      | 50            | 9.94M              | $6.96         | ~0.036 GB                  | $0.00        | ~0.00038 GB                    | Very safe; mostly for smoke tests |
| 0.5%       | 50,000         | 46,000     | 250           | 49.68M             | $34.78        | ~0.182 GB                  | $0.02        | ~0.00191 GB                    | Suggested beta default for high-QPS routes |
| 1.0%       | 100,000        | 92,000     | 500           | 99.36M             | $69.55        | ~0.365 GB                  | $0.04        | ~0.00381 GB                    | Good power for many metrics; watch scoring lag |
| 2.0%       | 200,000        | 184,000    | 1,000         | 198.72M            | $139.10       | ~0.729 GB                  | $0.09        | ~0.00763 GB                    | Consider tier gating + caps |
| 5.0%       | 500,000        | 460,000    | 2,500         | 496.80M            | $347.76       | ~1.823 GB                  | $0.22        | ~0.01907 GB                    | Expensive scorer time; only for short runs |

Interpretation
- Scoring compute dominates costs by ~3 orders of magnitude relative to telemetry ingestion/storage.
- Telemetry/storage is still important operationally (cardinality + query load + retention compliance), but it is not the budget driver in $ terms.


Monthlyized storage (rough, from defaults; same baseline R_prod_per_day)
We split “warehouse scored metrics” and “object artifacts”. This is rough; actual compression varies.

Warehouse (ShadowScoreEvent + aggregates)
- Score stream GB/day ~= (R_scored * 1.1KB) -> at 1% sampling: ~0.097 GB/day
- 30-day retention -> ~2.9 GB active
- Cost/month ~= 2.9 GB * $0.095/GB-month ~= $0.28/month (negligible)

Object artifacts (example drilldown)
- At 1% sampling: artifacts/day=500; ~0.0038 GB/day
- 3-day retention -> ~0.0114 GB active
- Cost/month ~= 0.0114 * $0.023 ~= $0.0003/month (negligible)

Conclusion: storage cost is noise at these sizes; main storage risk is *sensitive content handling* and *high-cardinality querying*, not spend.


Optional: Shadow inference cost estimator (NOT in-scope for observability budgets, but requested often)
If we want to estimate incremental shadow *candidate* inference cost (GPU), use:
- Avg total tokens per inference request (prompt+completion): tok_inf_total (e.g., 1,150)
- Shadow tokens/day: tok_shadow_day = R_shadow * tok_inf_total
- Unit GPU cost: C_inf = $X per 1M tokens (runtime-provided)
- Inference $/day = (tok_shadow_day / 1,000,000) * C_inf

Example (placeholder): tok_inf_total=1,150; C_inf=$1.25/1M tokens
- At 1% sampling (R_shadow=100,000): tok_shadow_day=115M tokens => ~$143.75/day
Compare vs scoring at 1%: ~$69.55/day (scoring is same order, sometimes lower depending on grader choice).


Sensitivity notes / knobs
1) Targets per request (T)
- All shadow/scoring/telemetry costs scale linearly with T.
- Recommendation (beta): cap T<=2 in UI; require support override for T>2.

2) Artifact keep-rate (a)
- Costs remain tiny, but artifacts increase security review surface area.
- Recommendation: keep a <= 0.5% by default; allow 0% (metrics-only mode) for regulated tenants.

3) Scoring eligibility (e)
- If we exclude streaming, long-context, or tool-calling initially, e drops and costs drop.
- BUT: exclusion changes representativeness; ensure dashboards show “coverage %”.

4) Scoring token size
- Rubric prompts are the big lever. If we can cut tok_score_total from 1,080 -> 650, that’s ~40% savings.
- Action: Jonas/Olivia to iterate rubric templates with hard token budgets.

5) Ingest cost model is not the real risk
- The true risk is dimension/cardinality blowups and query amplification.
- Enforce: no prompt_id, no raw user_id; bucket route_id; stable hashed fingerprint; limit free-form tags.


Guardrails (cost + safety) proposed defaults for beta
- s default: 0.5% for Dedicated beta tenants; 0.1% for Hosted self-serve
- s max (self-serve): 1.0% without support override
- Global scoring budget caps (per tenant):
  - soft cap: $100/day (warning + UI banner)
  - hard cap: $250/day (auto-throttle scoring queue; continue mirroring but skip scoring)
- “Fail-open”: if scoring queue lag > 30 min, disable scoring and keep minimal telemetry (pair outcome only)

Open questions / TODO
- Confirm blended cost C_score with Applied ML after dogfood (current $0.70/M tokens is a placeholder).
- Decide whether we do “always-score” vs “score sampled subset of shadow pairs” for very high-volume routes.
- Confirm default retentions for Private: likely 0 artifacts by default; score-only with local retention.
- Add line item for dashboard/query load (Looker/Grafana) once we have beta usage patterns.

Change log
- 2026-02-11: Updated scoring tokens (was 1,320) after rubric template trim; added budget cap proposal.
- 2026-02-03: Added artifact keep-rate knob and separate retention for artifacts vs scored metrics.
- 2026-01-16: Initial v0 table + placeholder rates.
